title: Curfew Library Add-Event Batch
description: Additive-only forever from Story 4.2 onward, same AD-15 discipline as sync-payload.schema.json. The SECOND sanctioned agent write (AD-21, after AD-20's status heartbeat) — a go-forward record of tracks entering the DJ's library, deliberately separate from the one-PUT-per-set SyncPayload (AD-4) because an add-event is not set-scoped. Language-neutral mirror of SyncLibraryAddEventBatch in @curfew/shared.

contract_version.description: Contract version this batch was produced against.

agent_version.description: Semver of the producing agent — same traceability role as SyncPayload.agent_version.

track_id.description: Opaque fnv1a_hex track identity (Story 4.2, D-2) — hashed from the volume-root-relative path, never the raw path. The same value SyncPlay.track_id carries, so a play joins its add-event by identity.

added_at.description: ISO 8601 (UTC) — when the library first saw this track, from database V2's tadd/uadd (same ~94% drive-dependent coverage ceiling as SyncPlay.library_added_at). null when no reachable catalogue covers the track — never guessed (AD-11); such tracks are excluded from cohort math and their count is always disclosed (D-10).
